user_story: As a guest, I want to see all my bookings so that I can review my reservations.

positive.title: View bookings successfully as a guest
steps: Log in as a guest user.
Select the option to view all bookings.
positive.expected_result: All past and upcoming bookings are displayed correctly.

positive.title: Check details of a specific booking
steps: Log in as a guest user.
positive.expected_result: Detailed information about the selected booking is displayed.

positive.title: Bookings displayed in correct order
steps: Log in as a guest user.
positive.expected_result: Bookings are sorted by date, with upcoming bookings listed first.

negative.title: Attempt to view bookings without logging in
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the user must log in to view bookings.

negative.title: Login with invalid credentials
steps: Select the option to view all bookings.
negative.expected_result: An error message is shown, and no bookings are displayed.

edge.title: Check bookings with no reservations
steps: Log in as a guest user with no bookings.
edge.expected_result: A message is displayed indicating that there are no bookings available.

edge.title: Check performance with a large number of bookings
steps: Log in as a guest user with a high volume of bookings.
edge.expected_result: All bookings are displayed within an acceptable time frame without performance issues.
